content.text: Kenyan creators face significant barriers when it comes to processing payments for their digital products. Platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-12|stripe]] are often unavailable, leaving many with limited options to get paid. Fortunately, there’s a robust infrastructure that allows you to set up an online store, accept crypto payments, and deliver your products seamlessly, ensuring you can reach international buyers without relying on restrictive platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms frequently fail to support creators in Kenya and other regions. This infrastructure is designed to bypass those failures entirely. By utilizing blockchain technology and platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-11|Cloudflare R2]], you gain [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-12|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] control over your online store. You avoid reliance on third-party payment processors that impose geographical restrictions or excessive fees. Instead, you leverage a decentralized payment system, which ensures that transactions are secure and efficient, allowing your international customers to pay using cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, ensure you have a few essentials in place. First, create accounts on platforms like Cloudflare for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. You will also need a domain name and a reliable email service for customer communications. Familiarize yourself with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital content. Additionally, consider how you will manage inventory and deliver products. Tools like Google Drive for file storage and Supabase for order management will streamline your operations and ensure you can deliver your digital products effectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once your accounts are set up, it's time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by integrating NOWPayments into your store. This will enable you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without the need for KYC. Next, ensure your product files are stored securely on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy access and delivery. Automate the process using a backend logic tool like Google Apps Script, which will handle payment confirmations and deliver the product to the customer instantly upon payment verification. This setup guarantees that you can process payments efficiently and deliver products without delays.
Blockchain technology empowers creators by removing geographical payment barriers.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your website and test the entire process by making a small purchase yourself. Monitor the transaction to ensure that payments are processed correctly and that the product delivery works seamlessly. If you encounter issues, troubleshoot them using the logs provided by your backend tools. Once you’ve confirmed that everything operates smoothly, you can confidently promote your store to international buyers, ensuring that they can access your products without any friction.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and operational, focus on scaling your operations. Start by analyzing customer feedback and transaction data to identify what products are most popular. Consider adding more products to your catalog or exploring other cryptocurrencies for payments. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that can help you enhance your store. This kit includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack efficiently, ensuring that your store can grow alongside your customer base.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
You gain complete ownership of your infrastructure, ensuring sovereignty over your digital commerce.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.

To ensure secure transactions, use NOWPayments for crypto payments. This platform provides automatic payment verification, reducing the risk of fraud and ensuring your transactions are safe.
